title: 熔岩灯小滴
style: translucent retro lava-lamp sculpture, yellow glass head and orange wax blobs, plum background
beats: An orange wax blob rises from the cheek
It stretches into a narrow-necked droplet inside the head
The droplet floats toward the upper-right
It separates into two connected lobes
The wax returns to its original cheek pool
